extracted.intended_audience: IP office statisticians, policymakers, researchers, and analysts who use WIPO trademark and procedural statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction and interpretation of WIPO statistical tables on trademarks and office procedural data (counts by office/origin, oppositions/appeals, registrations, in-force totals, and processing/performance metrics) for 2022. Includes data caveats and harmonization notes used when comparing offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party oppositions (pre-registration / post-registration / total)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of third-party oppositions for selected offices, broken down into pre-registration, post-registration, and total (2022). (Heading on table: 'Third-party oppositions for selected offices, 2022')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as office-level counts for 2022. Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2023. Caution: differences in application processing procedures between offices mean data cannot be fully harmonized; exercise caution when comparing across offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals against decisions (number of appeals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of appeals against decisions for selected offices (2022). (Heading on table: 'Appeals against decisions for selected offices, 2022')
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as office-level counts for 2022. Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2023. Caution about cross-office comparability due to procedural differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark applications by office and origin (application class counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Application class count by office and by origin for trademarks (2022), including breakdowns for Resident vs Non-resident, Total, Change over previous year, Application class count by origin, and Equivalent application class count by origin. Table heading: 'Trademark applications by office and origin, 2022'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Components included: Application class count by office (Resident and Non-resident), Change over previous year, Application class count by origin, Equivalent application class count by origin, Total (a). Footnotes/limitations: (a) Data by origin incomplete for some offices; (b) only Madrid designation data available for some territories; (c)/(d)/(e) notes on offices without a national office or resident definitions; (f)/(g)/(h) notes about aggregate direct counts, OAPI competence, non‑Madrid members. n.a. indicates not applicable; '..' indicates not available. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2023. Caution: procedural differences make full harmonization impossible; exercise caution when comparing across offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark registrations by office and origin, and trademarks in force
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration class count by office and by origin for trademarks, equivalent registration class counts by origin, and 'In force by office' totals (2022). Table heading: 'Trademark registrations by office and origin, and trademarks in force, 2022'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Components included: Registration class count by office (Resident, Non-resident, Total), Registration class count by origin, Equivalent registration class count by origin, In force by office, Change over previous year, Total (a). Footnotes/limitations: similar notes as for applications (Madrid-only data for some territories; resident definitions; aggregate direct counts). n.a. = not applicable; '..' = not available. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2023. Caution on cross-office comparability due to procedural differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark office procedural data (processing and performance metrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Office-level procedural indicators for trademark processing (2022), including: Total applications processed, Registered, Total rejections, Withdrawn or abandoned, Applications pending, Number of examiners (FTE), First office action (days), Final office decision (days). Table heading: 'Trademark office procedural data, 2022'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are operational/performance metrics collected via a common WIPO questionnaire. The table gives per-office values for each metric. Important methodological caveats: 'WIPO collects data from IP offices using a common questionnaire and methodology. Every effort has been made to compile procedural data based on common definitions and concepts, but procedural differences make it extremely difficult to fully harmonize such data. Therefore, caution should be exercised when making comparisons across offices. The total number of applications processed for a given office may be incomplete owing to the omission of one or several elements by the office.' n.a. and '..' meanings and other footnotes apply. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2023.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of application design counts to harmonize industrial design statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: For industrial designs, statistics based on the number of designs contained in industrial design applications—known as application design counts—are used to improve comparability across offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale and guidance: Application design counts harmonize data between offices that allow several designs per single application and those that allow only one, improving comparability worldwide. Example use: estimated number of designs contained in applications filed worldwide in 2022. Source: World Intellectual Property Indicators 2023 (text preceding tables).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data quality & footnote caveats (Madrid, Benelux/EU, OAPI, aggregate direct counts, n.a./.. indicators)
rubrics_metrics.description: Footnote-specified limitations and definitions that affect interpretation of the tables: e.g., (a) incomplete origin data, (b) only Madrid designation data available, (c) country without national office (Benelux/EU), (d)/(e) resident definitions, (f) aggregate direct counts not broken down, (g) OAPI competence, (h) territories not Madrid members, n.a. means not applicable, '..' means not available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These notes must be applied when using or comparing the tabulated figures. They indicate where counts are partial, where office/resident definitions differ, and where totals include aggregates that cannot be disaggregated. Always consult the specific footnotes for a given office before drawing comparisons or conclusions.
